hook.text: You used the same password on a gaming site and your bank. The gaming site got breached.

buildup.text: Credential stuffing tests stolen username-password pairs against hundreds of other websites.

discovery.text: Automated tools can test millions of stolen credentials across banking sites in hours.

twist.text: About 65% of people reuse passwords. That means one breach compromises multiple accounts.

climax.text: A password leaked from a forgotten forum can unlock your bank account years later.

punchline.text: One password everywhere means one breach everywhere.

quiz.question: What is credential stuffing?
options: Testing stolen credentials on multiple sites
